summary: Requested execution for the persistence accounting that a lost-save defect would corrupt. The harness builds an entryLog over the package test log, appends four term-1 entries, acknowledges all four as saved through an UpdateCommit, then appends a conflicting term-2 pair at indexes 3 and 4 and emits the entries-to-save range before and after along with the resulting last index and term. Registered the investigation with the hypothesis that the conflict lowers the saved index so replaced entries are reported again as unsaved. No conclusion before the receipt.
